title: Swapchain IRenderTarget::GetCurrentIndex() never follows the acquired image
body: VulkanSwapChain::scPublicVars.currentColorBuffer is only ever set to 0 (VulkanSwapChain.cpp:68,106,549); SwapChainNode keeps the acquired index in its own currentImageIndex. Any IRenderTarget consumer that asks a swapchain for its current image reads image 0. This made windowed AppFlow readbacks show the UI up to two actions behind (E6b); the editor now takes the index from SwapChainNode::GetCurrentImageIndex(). Fix at the source: set currentColorBuffer on acquire and audit SwapchainBarriers.h:139 and Fsr3Upscaler.cpp:421/442 (they would change behaviour). Tier: luna, a one-line fix plus an audit of three call sites with a render witness.

title: Editor reopen-parity witness has no AppFlow action; script gate leg dropped
body: R468.4 deleted the VIXEN_EDITOR_SCRIPT injector. Its reopen leg (ReopenSavedDocument: reload the saved file, compare program/parameters/mask, adopt it) cannot be reached through the channel because no FlowAction names it, so test_editor_toggle_undo_capture lost ParameterSnapshotAndSaveReopen reopen leg and the frame-115 byte-equality. Needs an appended action (for example ReopenSaved) in codegen/appflow-schemas/AppFlowReference.cs plus regeneration of AppFlow.g.h; deferred because sn-editorshape1 appends actions in the same file and the generated shape hash. ReopenSavedDocument is now public but unreferenced. Tier: luna after editorshape1 lands; needs the owner to confirm the action is wanted (owner-question).

title: Editor capture producer and channel client are Python (R812/R821 conversion)
body: tools/editor_capture_producer.py (new, drives the editor over the AppFlow channel) joins appflow_client.py, appflow_channel_gate.py and appflow_mcp_server.py as Python decision/driver logic that R812/R821 want in C#. The brief required the existing Python channel client to host the port (the gate CTest already requires Python3). Convert the channel client, producer, gate and MCP server to one C# tool with a parity test, then delete the Python. Tier: sol (four tools plus MCP transport).

title: Editor channel and capture CTests are DISABLED on Dozen, so laptop lanes cannot run them through ctest
body: vixen_set_suite_properties(GPU) and vixen_lock_gpu_tests set DISABLED TRUE when VIXEN_WSL_DZN_ICD is set (cmake/VixenTesting.cmake:323,342): vixen_editor_capture_producer, vixen_editor_appflow_channel_gate and the discovered EditorToggleUndoCapture.* cases report Not Run (Disabled) on the laptop. This lane ran the same producer and gate commands directly under the queue GPU resource instead. Also GpuSubmissionsRespectDeclaredBudget fails on Dozen with zero [GPUYIELD] samples, measured identical for a plain VIXEN_EXIT_AFTER_FRAMES editor run. The disable message should name the policy and the direct command, and the budget test should skip rather than fail off native drivers. Tier: haiku.

title: Rewrite measure-editor-latency.py on the AppFlow channel (script path retired)
body: tools/measure-editor-latency.py measured edit latency from the tick-locked VIXEN_EDITOR_SCRIPT timeline (toggle/parameter/create/delete/reorder/program_field cases, capture frames around ticks 30/60/90/120) and parsed the capture fixture command out of ctest JSON. R468.4 retired the script, so capturing now exits with an explanation (--analyse-only on existing captures still works). Rewrite as dispatch-with-attached-readback frame deltas from the reflected frame, per case, ideally as part of the C# channel tool (see the Python conversion proposal). Tier: luna.

title: run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh gained a command-after-dashes form (legacy shell, R821 port)
body: To retire VIXEN_EDITOR_SCRIPT the editor leg of tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh now runs the channel capture producer; run_capture needed a minimal change so arguments after -- are the command instead of the bare executable (about 8 lines, no new decision logic). The whole script is legacy shell that R812/R821 want in C#. The editor leg was not run on this lane (bash -n only); windowed captures include the UI because the producer reads the swapchain. Tier: haiku to run it once under the queue.
